//: Type-checks this package's JSX runtime, its own JSX example and the hero/parity apps against `tsc --strict` -- see the README's 'JSX' section. `paths` maps `@quadraui/node/*` to the generated `dist/*.d.ts` for the hero/parity apps, which live outside this package where its own name does not resolve; inside the package it resolves through the `exports` map the way an installed consumer's does. Needs `npm run build:debug` and `npm run build:dist` first. `npm run typecheck:jsx` resolves `tsc` from the hoisted `typescript@^5.9` devDependency (not the separate `typescript@6` `@napi-rs/cli` carries as its own nested dependency) -- this config is only ever exercised against 5.9, so a behavior difference in TS 6 (e.g. around the local-vs-global `JSX` namespace this runtime exports) would not be caught here.
